## Why

I chose a pair of Franciscan sandals, elevated as a sacred object and held by an armored fist, to visualize the encyclical "Exivi de Paradiso." This single recognizable object powerfully captures the core theme: the definition and enforcement of the Franciscan Rule of poverty (represented by the simple, worn sandals) by papl authority. The document is juridical, settling doubts and imposing strict obligations, which is symbolized by the sandals being 'raised' or set apart as precepts. An armored fist holding the delicate, humble sandals perfectly encapsulates the tension and the central action: the authoritative papal clarification ("precepts") surrounding the spiritual ideal of poverty ("counsels"). I rejected abstraction because a recognizable everyday devotional item like sandals provides immediate legibility and connects directly to the historical context of the Order of Friars Minor, which a purely abstract form could not do.

## Why

I chose a single pair of Franciscan sandals, presented upon an armored papal gauntlet. The sandals represent the very heart of the Franciscan Rule—the *usus pauper* or "poor use" of worldly goods, specifically clothing—which "Exivi de Paradiso" so precisely defines and enforces.

By choosing this recognizable, humble devotional item, I prioritize immediate recognizability over abstract geometry. The sandals are a direct symbol of the Franciscan spiritual ideal of poverty, making the subject feel inevitable rather than decorative. By resting the worn, soft sandals upon the hard, polished steel and gold-trimmed papal gauntlet, the sculpture embodies the specific action of this constitution: the central authority of the papacy (Clement V) reaching down to grasp, elevate, and impose strict, juridical definitions upon the doubts regarding the Franciscan Rule. The armored hand emphasizes the "tight grasp" and precise canonical definitions the Pope placed on these matters of poverty and observance.

Crucially, this selection passes the isolation test. Even on a transparent background, the pair of sandals tells the story of the Rule, and the juxtaposition with the armored gauntlet tells the story of papal clarification. The geometry remains concrete and recognizable throughout, ensuring legibility as a premium render without needing supplementary abstract symbols.

***
